no_opening_reason: No qualified S09 opening: P1 unloads only to the release rack, and those arrivals are the existing material connection supplying P2. The available controls provide trips, load selection, inspection starts and idling; they provide no independent way to remove that connection while preserving both operations. Floor storage and alternative routes or rack places are unavailable. Letting P2 inspect only the initial three carriers while P1 deposits more leaves the connection intact but unconsumed; withholding trips or inspections changes parent activity. Parent-alone and co-presence runs therefore cannot furnish a valid broken-link comparator. The supplied intact seven-minute and hand-carrier nine-minute schedules are hypotheses with the same connection, so their difference cannot discriminate interaction from a parent-only account. A separate interface control would be needed, but none is admitted.
